findings.title: Modified config copy is not used in monitor environment context
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into `config` and rewrites `schedule_type` to its display value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. As a result, the intended human-readable `schedule_type` transformation is lost and the occurrence event context contains the raw config.

findings.title: Failure threshold can be bypassed when fewer than threshold check-ins exist
findings.body: try_incident_threshold fetches up to failure_issue_threshold recent check-ins and only returns early if one of them is OK. It does not verify that the number of available failed check-ins is at least failure_issue_threshold. With threshold > 1, a monitor with only one failed check-in and no successful check-in will be marked ERROR and create a MonitorIncident, even though the configured failure threshold has not been reached.
